messages:
raj_support: FYI escalating Silverline Health — onboarding org 'silverline-trial' failing to create embeddings. Customer hit while ingesting ~12k docs. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-2345
ellie_cs: Thanks Raj. Is this blocking activation or is there a workaround?
raj_support: Blocking — embed calls return 502 from our hosted API intermittently. SDK v2.3.1. Error snippet pasted in the ticket. Happening across 3 regions (us-east-1 primary).
chris_csm: I can take comms with Silverline. Proposed plan: immediate acknowledgement + ETA + workaround. Want to set a daily 15m sync at 9am PT until resolved.
ellie_cs: Agreed. Assigning priority: P1 for onboarding flow and renewal-risk watch. I'll send the ack & escalation note to the customer now.
maria_eng: Investigating — initial triage shows KV cache backend throwing OOM on larger batch windows. We can temporarily force batching to size 8 or fall back to model-quantized variant. Rolling a patch to limit batch_size by tenant. ETA ~3h for canary.
oncall_bot: Deployment pipeline kicked: rollout job 78421 started for service inference-gateway (canary). See https://ci.redwood.com/78421
ellie_cs: Comm plan draft (to send to Silverline PM): 1) Acknowledge (now) 2) Provide workaround: switch to batched endpoint w/ batch_size=8 OR set quantized_model=true in request 3) ETA for fix: ~3-4 hours, hourly status updates 4) Offer dedicated engineer bridge if still failing after patch
chris_csm: I'll add the outreach message and include a short playbook for their SREs. pinging @maria_eng for the exact config snippet.
maria_eng: Snippet for workaround:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","inputs":[...],"batch_size":8}'
```
Also alternative: add header `X-Use-Quantized: true` to force lower memory path.
ellie_cs: Sending ack now and scheduling the 9am PT sync. Link to internal incident doc: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/silverline-5243001234
chris_csm: Noted. I'll be on the bridge for the customer call. If patch fails, we escalate to Dedicated support for temporary reserved capacity.
raj_support: Thanks all — I'll update the ticket with the workaround and monitoring checks to watch error rate down to <1% before we close.
ellie_cs: Closing loop: will post hourly status in this thread and update renewal risk tracker if >24h. :thumbsup:
